date.as_written: 1664 śāke || saṃvat 1799 || vāre 2 tithau 2 nakṣatra (!) 17 māse 7

notes: The catalogue erroneously lists 'NS 1799'; the colophon provides Śāke 1664 and Saṃvat 1799, which is Vikrama Saṃvat (1664 ŚS corresponds exactly to 1799 VS / 1742 CE). Place refers to Tanahu/Tanahun, near Śuklā (likely Śuklagandaki) at Tulasi-sthāna.
